This is a senior-level, hands-on software engineering role focused on ad tech, where you'd act as the subject-matter expert and end-to-end owner of a header bidding wrapper built on Prebid.js and Prebid Server. The work centers on Freestar's publisher monetization platform, improving ad revenue and page performance across thousands of publisher sites while protecting Core Web Vitals like INP, LCP, and CLS. The core stack is JavaScript and TypeScript on the client, Google Ad Manager with GPT and the IMA SDK, and Google Cloud Platform services such as GKE, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, and BigQuery for high-throughput backend services.
